name: ow
title: Obby Wiki
description: Quickly open and create pages on Obby Wiki.
author: wlft

commands.name: open-page
commands.title: Open Page
commands.description: Open a page on the Obby Wiki by title.

commands.name: random-page
commands.title: Random Page
commands.description: Open a random Obby Wiki page.

commands.name: random-obby
commands.title: Random Obby
commands.description: Open a random Obby page on the Obby Wiki.

commands.name: edit-page
commands.title: Edit Page
commands.description: Edit or create a page on the Obby Wiki.

arguments.name: page_title
arguments.description: The title of the page to edit or create.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
